correctness.rationale: The complete proof derives the Gram matrix, its inverse action, and the exact residual. Orthogonality to degrees 0,1,2 supplies at least three interior sign changes, the strictly negative third derivative proves at most three, and rational quartic brackets give locations. The constant moment makes true and fitted disk means identical; hence the normalized small-planet residual has the claimed zeros. Standalone checker verifies the algebra and physical example.
